title: Fragrant Beef and Butternut Squash Stew
description: A Vietnamese-inspired braise of beef, carrots and butternut squash simmered with lemongrass, ginger, Chinese five spice and fish sauce.
ingredients: 1 lemon grass stalk, trimmed and finely chopped
30g (1oz) fresh root ginger, peeled and grated
TO SERVE: coriander leaves, lime wedges
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C/160°C fan (350°F), Gas Mark 4.
Spray a large flameproof casserole dish (with a lid) with oil and stir-fry the beef and onions for 5 minutes. Add the garlic, lemon grass and ginger and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Pour in the hot stock and add the Chinese 5 spice, tomato purée, soy sauce and fish sauce.
Stir in the carrots and butternut squash, place a lid on and cook on the middle shelf of the oven for 1.5 hours until the beef is tender.
Serve scattered with coriander, and with lime wedges on the side.
notes: Inspired by Vietnamese flavours. Also lovely served with rice.
